items.title: Arroyo del Oso and Bear Canyon Trail Guide
items.description: Provides mile-by-mile directions for the 7.9-mile Arroyo del Oso and Bear Canyon Trail from Embudito Trailhead to North Diversion Channel, documenting parking, arterial crossings, parks, CNM Montoya, Osuna connections, and the I-25 bicycle bridge.
items.provenance_status: official City trail-guide library and byte-identical source file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative two-page PDF preserved without modification.
The current official City collection provides only this brief edition; no full version is listed.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; both rendered pages were visually reviewed.
